title: Troy Fraker, 2 mins on Oracle Advanced Customer Support
description: Troy Fraker 2 min elevator pitch on Oracle Advanced Customer Support - What ACS is, what ACS does, and how ACS can assist customers as they make their journey to the Oracle Cloud.

asr.full_text: Hello, my name is Troy Fraker, Account Executive with Oracle Advanced Customer Support responsible for serving state and local government customers within the North American Central Region. Advance Customer Support, or ACS, operates globally as a part of Oracle Customer Support services and works side by side with Oracle development to deliver a broad range of high value support services, which build upon Oracle Premier Support to assist our customers in maximizing solution availability and performance. Our over 4K customers span all major industries and include 84% of Fortune 100 companies and 82% of top 50 world governments. If you are an Oracle customer, no doubt you're familiar with, Premier Support, the award winning standard support service that entitles you to product performance and feature enhancements, bug fixes, critical patches, 24-7 remote response, and access to the My Oracle Support portal. Always leveraging Premier Support, what ACS does is, address any gaps that exist between your Premier Support entitlements versus your organization's unique support requirement. Regardless of whether your support requirements are at the planning and design, build and deploy, support and maintain, or optimize and modernize stage of the IT lifecycle, Oracle Advanced Customer Support has service offerings for every Oracle product including traditional on premise and cloud. And with respect to cloud, I'm sure that you would agree that the term cloud, as well as all of the other cloud terminology, has become somewhat ubiquitous these days. As you might know, Oracle is the only company that can offer a complete and integrated solution that connects all of the variations of cloud and on-premise. So regardless of how your journey to the cloud continues to unfold, know this, Oracle Advanced Customer Support is there with current support offerings, such as our cloud business help desk or the enablement and support of our absolutely game-changing product, the Oracle Cloud Machine. Many things changed with the cloud, but one of the constants is that it does adhere to an IT lifecycle, and ACS helps customers take advantage of cloud computing every step of the way. With ACS customers can prevent risk, accelerate and optimize their way to the cloud. And finally just with Oracle on-premise stack, ACS' mission remains. And that is, maximizing the performance, availability and value of Oracle Cloud solutions. I appreciate your attentiveness, and I threw a lot of information at you. Here's my contact information. If you're interested in obtaining the highest value possible from your Oracle investment by lowering your support costs and increasing availability and performance, reach out. We can schedule a deeper conversation. I am quite confident that you feel your time was well spent.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents Oracle Advanced Customer Support and explains how it helps Oracle customers with cloud and IT-lifecycle work. Its call to action invites interested customers to schedule a conversation about support services, without requesting money, credentials, or participation in an investment opportunity.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary content is an ordinary business-service presentation describing Oracle customer-support offerings and inviting prospective customers to discuss those services.
